items.title: Fix fan_out() to include 'paid_calls' in successful return
items.why_now: Confirmed bug: successful return of fan_out() omits 'paid_calls' key present in refusal return, risking KeyError in callers. High severity.

steps.do: Edit daedalus/lanes/fanout.py to add 'paid_calls' key to the dictionary returned on success (around line 460).
steps.verified_by: Run `grep -rn 'paid_calls' daedalus/lanes/fanout.py` and verify both return paths include 'paid_calls'.

items.assumption: The fix is a simple addition; no callers break if they already handle optional key.

steps.do: Inspect daedalus/structcore/markdown.py's code_modules function to see if it filters out non-code files.
